statement: The dead setThresholds API on the split/merge manager is removed or wired: setThresholds (partition-split-merge-manager-evaluation-methods.js) has zero production callers — either delete it (and its test-only surface) so threshold drift has exactly one owner, or wire it into the configuration authority with a durable effect; a half-wired mutator that silently drifts evaluation behavior must not survive. doneWhen: the test-receipt probe reads solve/evidence/dead-setthresholds-removal.receipt.json with outstanding 0 — single-threshold-owner and no-dead-mutator receipts all passing.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Each new regression test must fail when the corresponding mechanism is reverted while the rest of the change remains.
The oracle evidence files must be written by a deterministic evidence harness that re-runs the recorded proof commands (focused test files, red-on-revert probes) and writes the receipt artifact.
Threshold state must have exactly one mutation owner (F24): a dead mutator that bypasses the configuration authority is deleted, not kept for hypothetical callers.
